facts.fact: StackAdapt and Experian announced a strategic collaboration on September 17, 2024, integrating Experian's identity graph and more than 2,400 syndicated and custom audiences into the StackAdapt platform.
facts.quote: integrating Experian’s identity graph and Experian’s more than 2,400 syndicated audiences and custom audiences for activation within the StackAdapt platform

facts.fact: The StackAdapt and Experian real-time first-party data onboarding improvements are available to advertisers in the United States and Canada.
facts.quote: offers improvements for real-time first-party data onboarding capabilities for advertisers in the United States and Canada

facts.fact: StackAdapt states it is rated the number 1 demand-side platform (DSP) on G2.
facts.quote: is rated [the number 1 demand-side platform](https://www.stackadapt.com/best-demand-side-platform-dsp) (DSP) on G2

facts.fact: Experian describes itself as a FTSE 100 Index company with a team of 22,500 people across 32 countries.
facts.quote: As a FTSE 100 Index company listed on the London Stock Exchange (EXPN), we have a team of 22,500 people across 32 countries.

facts.fact: Experian's corporate headquarters are in Dublin, Ireland, according to the press release.
facts.quote: Our corporate headquarters are in Dublin, Ireland.

facts.fact: Experian's identity graph (Experian Consumer Sync Identity Graph) is used with Consumer View audiences to power the collaboration, per Experian's Chief Business Officer.
facts.quote: the combination of Experian Consumer Sync Identity Graph and Consumer View audiences

facts.fact: Through the integration, advertisers can attach addressable IDs to uploaded first-party email lists to reach customers across display, video, CTV, audio and other channels.
facts.quote: they will be able to attach addressable IDs to those emails to reach their customers across all channels including display, video, CTV, audio, and more.
